output: html_document
---

### 1.Clear the Environment
```{r}
rm(list=ls())
```

### 2.Loading Required Packages for Heatmap
```{r}
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
library(reshape2)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggnewscale)
```

### 3.Reading the File
```{r}
df <- read_excel("gene_expression_annotation.xlsx")
```

### 4.Extracting Target Genes
```{r}
target_genes <- c("Trim47", "Neurl3")
fpkm_df <- df %>% 
  filter(gene_name %in% target_genes) %>%
  select(gene_name, 
         CON1_FPKM,
         CON2_FPKM,
         CON3_FPKM,
         'ICI-AM_1_FPKM',
         'ICI-AM_2_FPKM',
         'ICI-AM_3_FPKM')
```

### 5.Data Processing
```{r}
## Convert FPKM columns to numeric type
fpkm_df <- fpkm_df %>%
  mutate(across(-gene_name, ~ as.numeric(as.character(.))))

## Handle possible NA values
fpkm_df[is.na(fpkm_df)] <- 0

## Perform log2 transformation on the data
log2_df <- fpkm_df %>%
  mutate(across(-gene_name, ~ log2(. +1)))

## Calculate Z-score (row-wise standardization)
zscore_matrix <- log2_df %>%
  column_to_rownames("gene_name") %>%
  as.matrix() %>%
  t() %>%    ## Transpose for row-wise calculation
  scale() %>%    ## Calculate Z-score
  t()    ## Transpose back to original orientation

## Add group information (for separator lines)
group_info <- data.frame(
  Sample = colnames(zscore_matrix),
  Group = rep(c("Control", "ICI-AM"), each = 3)
)

## Convert to long format for ggplot
zscore_melt <- zscore_matrix %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("Gene") %>%
  melt(id.vars = "Gene",
       variable.name = "Sample",
       value.name = "Zscore"
       )

## Add group information
zscore_melt <- zscore_melt %>%
  left_join(group_info, by = "Sample")
```

### 6.Creating the Heatmap
```{r}
group_data <- data.frame(
  Sample = unique(zscore_melt$Sample),
  Group = c(rep("Control", 3), rep("ICI-AM", 3))
)
heatmap_plot <- ggplot() +
  ## Add group labels at the top
  geom_tile(
    data = group_data,
    aes(x = Sample, y = Inf, fill = Group),   ## y=Inf places the tile at the top
    height = 0.5,    ## Control tile height
    color = NA    ## Remove borders
  ) +
  ## Top label colors
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Group",    ## Group legend title
    values = c("Control" = "#4E84C4", "ICI-AM" = "#D16103")
  ) +
  ## Declare a new fill scale
  new_scale_fill() +
  ## Add cell borders
  geom_tile(
    data = zscore_melt,
    aes(x = Sample, y = Gene, fill = Zscore),
    color = "black", linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  ## Add group separator line
  geom_vline(xintercept = 3.5, color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
  ## Add numeric labels
  geom_text(data = zscore_melt,
            aes(x = Sample, y = Gene, label = sprintf("%.1f", Zscore)), 
            size = 4,
            color = "black") +
  ## Set color gradient
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#2166AC",
    mid = "white",
    high = "#B2182B",
    midpoint = 0,
    name = "Z-score"
  ) +
  ## Theme settings - pure white background
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 15, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right",
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    ## Set all backgrounds to pure white
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    ## Remove other background elements
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
  ) +
  ## Label settings
  labs(
    title = "Expression of Trim47 and Neurl3 genes",
    x = NULL, 
    y = NULL
  ) +
  ## Ensure the heatmap is square
  coord_fixed()
```

### 7.Saving the Plot
```{r}
ggsave("Fig. 1c.pdf", 
       plot = heatmap_plot,
       width = 8,
       height = 6,
       dpi = 300,
       bg = "white"
       )
```
